mapper.select: SELECT sys11_relate_file_id AS relate_file_id, sys11_file_id AS file_id, sys11_parent_id AS parent_id, sys10_file_nm AS file_name, sys10_reg_date AS reg_date FROM sys11_relate_file INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_file_id = sys11_file_id WHERE sys11_parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY sys10_reg_date DESC, sys10_file_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu"

SELECT sys10_file_id AS file_id, sys10_reg_date AS reg_date, f_cdnm('LawType', sys10_law_type, 0, f_sysdate()) AS law_name, sys10_note AS note, sys10_file_nm AS file_name FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = 0 AND COALESCE(f_cdnm('LawType', sys10_law_type, 0, f_sysdate()),'')||COALESCE(sys10_note,'')||sys10_file_nm LIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY sys10_reg_date DESC, sys10_law_type, sys10_note
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys11_relate_file ( sys11_relate_file_id, sys11_file_id, sys11_parent_id, sys11_parent_table ) VALUES ( #{relateFileId}, #{fileId}, #{parentId}, #{parentTable} )
